definitions.content: Quantity of product in a prepackage declared on the label.

notes.content: In some national legislation the nominal quantity of the product is referred to as "net quantity", "net contents", "net mass" or "net volume".
This term relates to specifications on a prepackage and does not account for the actual quantity in an individual prepackage.
